cities.name: Warsaw
cities.local_food_tip: Try pierogi, żurek soup, zapiekanka (open‑faced sandwich) and Polish street‑food snacks — hearty and comforting. 🥟🍲🍞
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🕍 Walk through the Old Town — Royal Castle, colourful reconstructed houses, historic streets → ☕ Coffee and pastry in central square.

Afternoon: 🖼️ Visit one of the city museums or modern galleries → 🍽️ Lunch: traditional Polish dish like pierogi or żurek soup at local bistro.

Sunset: 🌇 Stroll along Vistula River banks or parks — city skyline meets river light.

Night: 🌃 Dinner in a cozy restaurant, maybe try local craft beer or dessert — enjoy modern‑historical blend of Warsaw under city lights.

ideas: 🌸 Blooming parks and mild weather — perfect for urban strolls.
🎭 Outdoor cultural events, street cafés reopening after winter.
🚶 Exploring historical and modern mix of the city centre.
☀️ Warm days, long evenings — ideal for walking, river‑side picnics, open‑air events.
🍦 Ice‑cream, outdoor dining and vibrant urban nightlife.
🌆 Sunset panorama from city hills or river banks.
🍁 Autumn in city parks — beautiful for photos and calm walks.
🍲 Hot soups, traditional meals in cosy cafés after sightseeing.
🏛️ Museum‑visits on cooler or rainy days — mix of history and comfort.
❄️ Light dusting of snow on historic streets, atmospheric Old Town under soft light.
☕ Warm drinks, hearty food and indoor cultural events — cozy urban stay.
🎄 Festive markets, seasonal decorations and calm winter city vibe.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Metro, trams and buses cover the city well — ideal for tourists and local sightseeing.
🚶 Old Town and central districts are walkable — convenient for short visits.
🎟️ Use city‑pass for transport + museum discounts if visiting many sites.
🚲 Bike‑rental or scooters work well for short hops and exploring riverside paths.

city_events.name: Warsaw Summer Festivals
city_events.description: 🎶 Outdoor concerts, cultural events, street art and vibrant summer city life.

cities.name: Kraków
cities.local_food_tip: Try pierogi, obwarzanki (Polish bagel‑style), hearty stews and local breads — great after long walks through historic streets. 🥟🍞🍲
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏯 Wawel Castle & Cathedral visit → Walk through Main Square and historic alleys → ☕ Coffee in old town café.

Afternoon: 🏘️ Explore Jewish Quarter or Kazimierz district, small museums and local shops → 🍽️ Lunch: traditional Polish dish in a tavern.

Sunset: 🌇 Walk along the Vistula River banks or historic bridges — lovely light and calm views over city.

Night: 🌙 Night strolls through old town, enjoy local bars or cultural events — blend of history and modern youth‑energy.

ideas: 🌸 Historic streets under soft spring light — perfect za šetnje i posete znamenitostima.
🚶 Walking tours and street‑art, relaxed tempo pre turističke sezone.
🍦 Early‑season ice‑cream and outdoor cafés as weather milder.
☀️ Long days for sightseeing, walking and exploring hidden corners of old town.
🎭 Festivals, concerts and cultural events — vibrant student & tourist energy.
🌙 Evening dinners, gelato, nightlife — old city under warm summer nights.
🍂 Autumn leaves around historic buildings — odlična atmosfera za šetnje i fotografije.
🔥 Hearty meals and soups in traditional taverns — savršeno posle dana razgledanja.
🏛️ Museums & galleries za hladnije dane.
❄️ Old Town sa snegom ili maglom — mistična i fotogenična atmosfera.
☕ Topli napici, domaća jela i kamin — idealno za opuštanje posle hladnog dana.
🎄 Božićni marketi, zimski ugođaj i mirnije ulice.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Buses and trams for farther suburbs; old town i centar istraži pešice.
🚶 Most monuments su blizu — idealno pešačenje kroz istoriju i ulice.
🚕 Taxi ili bike ako planiraš izlete van centra (sladoled, priroda, planine).

city_events.name: Kraków Historic Nights & Festivals
city_events.description: 🎭 Street concerts, cultural events, historic city tours — perfect mix of old and new.

cities.name: Gdańsk
cities.local_food_tip: Seafood, fresh fish, Baltic‑style dishes, smoked herring, breads and coastal salads — fresh and flavorful. 🐟🥖🥗
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Walk through historic old town — colourful buildings, waterfront, old harbors → ☕ Breakfast near riverside.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Visit maritime museums or explore coastal piers → 🍽️ Lunch: fresh fish or seafood by the sea.

Sunset: 🌇 Stroll along the Baltic‑coast promenade or beach — sun setting over sea + city skyline.

Night: 🌙 Dinner by water, seaside cafés or bars — calm Baltic night atmosphere.

ideas: 🌿 Mild weather — good for walking promenades before summer crowds.
🚶 Exploring old town + harbour + sea — fresh start of season.
🍷 Try seafood and local dishes with Baltic flavour in calm environment.

summer.event: Summer by the Baltic & Beach Days
ideas: 🏖️ Beach days, seaside walks, sun and sea breeze — classic summer escape.
🍨 Ice‑cream, beach‑bars, seafood dinners near water under long days.
🎉 Summer nightlife by the coast — relaxed and fun seaside vibe.
🍂 Coast under golden light — perfect for photography and peaceful walks.
🔥 Warm seafood dinners, local wines and cozy restaurants near harbour.
📚 Museum visits or indoor cultural tours if weather cooler or rainy.
🌫️ Foggy sea, calm harbour — mystic coastal atmosphere in off‑season.
☕ Hot soups, coastal food, cozy indoors nearby old town after sea walks.
🛏️ Quiet town, fewer tourists — ideal za miran beg od gužve.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams and buses — good za prelazak između starih delova i novih kvartova.
🚶 Old town i centra je lako pešačiti — blizu je sve što vredi posetiti.
🚤 Za obalu i manja mesta — brod ili trajekt ako planiraš izlete uz more.
🚗 Iznajmljen auto može da koristiš za istraživanje okolnih plaža i priobalja.

city_events.name: Gdańsk Summer Baltic Fest
city_events.description: 🌅 Beach walks, sea‑side concerts, maritime vibes and coastal holidays by the Baltic.

cities.name: Wrocław
interests: Historic Old Town & Bridges over Rivers 🌉
cities.local_food_tip: Try traditional Polish dishes — pierogi, soups, local breads and pastries; good after long city walks through rivers and bridges. 🥟🍞🍰
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Walk historic market square, colourful houses, old town centre → ☕ Coffee at riverside café.

Afternoon: 🚶 Explore riverside paths, walk across multiple bridges and small islands inside city → 🍽️ Lunch: local dish in a cosy tavern.

Sunset: 🌇 Sunset from a bridge or riverside terrace — calm water reflections and nice city‑light views.

Night: 🌃 Cultural events, art galleries or relaxed dinners & strolls — vibrant city with local charm.

ideas: 🌸 Flowers and spring colours around rivers and old town — super za izlete i fotografije.
🚶 Lagane šetnje kroz grad, istraživanje starih ulica i reka bez gužve.
🍦 Sladoled i kafa pored reke posle razgledanja.
☀️ Dunav‑like rijeke (actually Oder) i mostovi + duge letnje večeri — idealno za chill i druženje uz vodu.
🎶 Festival, koncerti ili barovi pored reke — gradska letnja energija.
🚲 Bicikl ili šetnja kroz zelene delove grada + reka, idealno za relaks.
🍁 Zlatne boje drveća i reka + stari grad — odlična atmosfera za šetnje i relaksaciju.
🔥 Topla jela, lokalne čorbe i peciva u tavernama — komfor posle dana istraživanja.
🏛️ Posete muzejima, galerijama i kulturnim mestima u zatvorenom nakon kiše ili hladnog vremena.
❄️ Stari grad pod snegom, reke sa maglom i mostovi — bajkovit i miran zimski ambijent.
☕ Topli napici, peciva i domaća jela u lokalnim kafanama posle šetnje po hladnom gradu.
📚 Unutrašnji obilasci (museumi, galerije) kad je hladno ili sneg — kulturni zimski beg.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Tramvaj i autobusi pokrivaju grad — dobra opcija za prelazak većih razdaljina unutar grada.
🚶 Stari grad i centar su pešački pristupačni — najviše ćeš koristiti noge za razgledanje.
🚲 Bicikli su dobra opcija za reke, šetališta i rečne staze leta/nice weather.
🎟️ Ako planiraš više atrakcija i muzeja — proveri lokalne turističke karte ili popuste.

city_events.name: Wrocław Bridges & Culture Week
city_events.description: 🎨 Street art, river‑side events, music and local culture around bridges & old town.

cities.name: Zakopane
cities.local_food_tip: Try hearty mountain foods — oscypek (smoked cheese), soups, stews, local breads and warm dishes — perfect after hiking or cold weather. 🧀🍲🥖
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🥾 Hike or take cable‑car up nearby trails/hills → Enjoy panoramic mountain views → ☕ Breakfast in a cosy mountain‑style café.

Afternoon: 🚶 Explore valleys or mountain paths, lakes or forested areas → 🍽️ Lunch: mountain stew or hearty traditional Polish meal.

Sunset: 🌇 Sunset from viewpoint or mountain ridge — amazing panorama over Tatras.

Night: 🌙 Warm dinner, local folklore music or calm evening walk — mountain town charm under starry sky.

ideas: 🌿 Budding nature and melting snow — perfect za prolećne planinske izlete.
🚶 Quiet trails, fewer turisti — mir i priroda za sebe.
🔥 Warm jela i domaće vino nakon planinarenja.
🏞️ Hiking, trekking, lakes or forest walks under sun and planinski vazduh.
🥾 Dnevni izleti, planinsko osvježenje i piknici u prirodi.
🌌 Noći pod zvezdama, čist vazduh i planinski mir.
🍂 Jesenje boje brda i dolina — fotke i mirne šetnje.
🔥 Hearty jela, toplina i planinski ugođaj u domaćim tavernama.
🚶 Lagane šetnje uz prirodu i planinsku tišinu.
⛷️ Skiing, snow hikes, sneg i zimski sportovi u Tatrama — zimska avantura na snegu.
🔥 Topla domaća jela, čaj, planinska atmosferа posle dana na snegu.
✨ Snowy ulice, planinska svetla i zimski šarm malog grada.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Buses or minibuses from Kraków or other major cities — često najbolji izbor za dolazak.
🚶 Town je kompaktan — centar i staze su lako dostupni pešice.
🚞 Ski‑lifts / cable‑cars za brži pristup planinama — zgodno za izlete/skijanje.
🎒 Za planinske ture — dobra obuća, planinarska oprema i proveri vreme pre polaska.

city_events.name: Zakopane Winter & Mountain Festival
city_events.description: 🏔️ Ski events, winter hikes, folklore & mountain culture in Polish Tatra mountains.
